title: Life of the Monsoon
description: The monsoon is a seasonal rain and wind pattern that occurs over South Asia (among other places). Through NASA satellites and models we can see the monsoon patterns like never before. Monsoon rains provide important reservoirs of water that sustain human activities like agriculture and supports the natural environment through replenishment of aquifers. However, too much rainfall routinely causes disasters in the region, including flooding of the major rivers and landslides in areas of steep topography.
keywords: Atmospheric Science, Seasons, Water Cycle, Precipitation, Monsoons, Sea Surface Temperature, India, Nepal, Asia, Southeast Asia, Wind Patterns, Earth
